mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over a 6-month window signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0% and remains above for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 exceeding 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered quarters despite the GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >0.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL by more than 0.3% month-over-month indicates a restrictive policy stance coinciding with falling inflation, which historically has been associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL falls by > -0.3% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 12-month moving averages signals increased housing and savings activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both exceed their 12-month moving averages in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS rising while UNRATE remains flat or falling over three consecutive months indicates robust job creation without wage inflation, which supports corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months while UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annualized decline in GDPC1 below 1% for more than two consecutive quarters signals a mild growth slowdown that does not trigger recession, resulting in muted but positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth < 1% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes.
